# Brett Goldstein

> Brett Goldstein runs Micro and Launch House Ventures, writes on X, LinkedIn and Homescreen, and makes music as Monte Del Monte.

This is a small personal homepage. The canonical URL is https://brettgoldstein.com/.

## Primary Page

- [Homepage](https://brettgoldstein.com/): Short biographical homepage with links to Brett's companies, writing, music, and contact channels.

## Links

- [Micro](https://micro.com): Company Brett runs.
- [Launch House Ventures](https://launchhouse.com): Founder-led early-stage fund Brett runs.
- [X](https://x.com/thatguybg): Brett's X profile and DM channel.
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/brettgoldstein): Brett's LinkedIn profile and DM channel.
- [Homescreen](https://homescreen.substack.com): Brett's writing.
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/montedelmonte): Music by Monte Del Monte.
